newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds to stall before aiming for 114-08.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds to stall before aiming for 114-08.

text.p: September T-bond futures are set for an eventual move higher initially to 114-08, but they may be held in the current range for Wednesday, techncial analysts said.
"The move on July 3 from 112-01 to 113-15 created a pole and now we see a potential bullish flag formation," said Anil Patel, technical analyst at Nomura International in London.
"There might be a bit of consolidation here and then we will be heading for the key target of 114-08 high of February 18."
Patel said that level coincided with the cash yield of 6.5 percent.
At 1030 GMT September T-bond futures were at 113-22 in automated trade, up 2/32 from Tuesday's Chicago close.
Analysts at a European bank in London said the overall uptrend in T-bonds seen since April was picking up pace.
"Resistance currently doesn't seem to be very effective," they said in a research note. "In this runaway mode consider potential selling pressure at 114-3/4."
To the downside, Patel said any pull back would meet initial support at 113-12, Tuesday's low, with a further prop at 113-03, the low on Monday.
"Any slippage (beyond there) will test 50 percent of Thursday's move, which comes in at 112-24," he said.
Well below 112-24, he noted a trendline drawn through the low of 106-30 on April 28 and the low of 108-17 at May 27 on the continuation chart.
"That level comes in way down at 110-26 today and the fact that the market has avoided any move towards that line suggests that it's potentially very bullish," Patel said.
At the short end, December Eurodollars were at 94.060, unchanged on the day.
